compositionEvidence.summary: Draft assembled from all eight accepted packaged parts with the supplied camera unchanged. The composition keeps a pale paper support, a central broken grid clearing, a readable smudged Trump cue, circular frame pressure, wet/dry contour revision, and restrained red/dark accents.
decisions: The environment was changed from dark technical support to pale inside-facing paper field so accepted dark-register modules read against the palette authority rather than a generic black void.

The primary fractured-grid-lane was kept central and broad, while the smudged-public-face-cue was shifted left so the selected-news public figure cue does not remain clipped off the right edge in mobile evidence.
Mechanical arcs, wet/dry marks, red/dark accents, and slow wash rhythm were stacked at nearby shallow depths to preserve the declared horizontal registers without replacing module refs or asset refs.
Output grade is renderer-owned and subtle: mild contrast, saturation, exposure, and vignette only; no generated post surface or WebGL-only effect was introduced.

takeaways: Router kept the consultation scoped to validation and output grade instead of new module authoring.
Visual validation takeaway applied as fixed-camera, fixed-draft Playwright evidence across desktop, mobile, and surround-360 views.
Exposure/color grading takeaway applied as a single subtle renderer-level outputColorTransform, not as a substitute for piece transforms.
